analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: Psychoactive drugs act mainly on neuronal receptors and transporters that are poorly expressed in these non-neuronal cell lines, so they should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other GABA/benzodiazepine receptor modulators, which similarly depend on neuronal receptor expression.
